item.title: Shared Closet Organization for Two People With Different Routines
item.description: Dividing a closet exactly down the middle sounds fair, but it often wastes space and starts arguments. One person may hang most of their clothes while the other folds them. One may need office wear every morning while the other has more casual clothing or sports gear. This guide builds a shared closet around each person’s real volume, method and routine. It includes a worked rod-length example, a zone plan, habit-friendly ideas and a two-week review.
